scripts.lint: pnpm run biome:lint && pnpm run scripts:lint && pnpm run web:lint && pnpm run worker:lint && pnpm run infra:lint
scripts.format: pnpm run biome:format && pnpm run worker:format && pnpm run infra:format
scripts.test: pnpm run web:test && pnpm run worker:test && pnpm run infra:test
scripts.web:lint: pnpm --dir web exec next typegen && pnpm --dir web exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.web:test: pnpm --dir web test && pnpm --dir web test:e2e
scripts.worker:lint: uv --directory worker run ruff check . && uv --directory worker run ruff format --check . && uv --directory worker run mypy pipeline
scripts.worker:format: uv --directory worker run ruff check --select I --fix . && uv --directory worker run ruff format .
scripts.infra:test: bash -c 'source scripts/lib/terraform.sh && "$(tf_get_bin)" -chdir=infra test' && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s infra/lambda && scripts/dev/terraform-test-lib.sh
